source.author: lucan
source.text: Hactenus armorum discrimina: cetera bello Fata dedit variis incertus motibus aer.
source.text_original: Hactenus armorum discrimina: cetera bello / Fata dedit variis incertus motibus aer.
source.text_english: Thus far the clashes of arms; the rest of the war the Fates gave over to the air, uncertain in its varying movements.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: ira maris vastique placent discrimina ponti.
reuse.text_original: ira maris vastique placent discrimina ponti.
reuse.text_english: The wrath of the sea and the perils of the vast deep delight them.
